text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — ACME just escalated. Their dedicated pool did not scale up fast enough during a traffic bounce, causing ~30% 429s and p95 latency spikes. They say min_replicas didn't increase.

lisa_support: Customer reports this started at ~15:42 UTC, traffic spiked from 10rps -> 120rps in ~40s. They attached a short curl loop showing 429s.

maria_cs: Pasting the curl they used: ```for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://api.redwood.test/prod/acme/endpoint; done```

raj_eng-runtime: Looking at autoscaler logs for that pool now. Can you share org+pool id?

maria_cs: org acme-corp, pool acme-prod-eu, request id from customer: req-2024-ACME-77.

autoscale-bot: autoscaler-event: [2441204828] scale_decision(pool=acme-prod-eu): current_replicas=2, desired_replicas=10, reason=traffic_jump, cooldown=30s, outstanding_provision=0

devin_oncall: Interesting — bot shows desired=10 but outstanding_provision=0 meaning no nodes were provisioning. Could be image-pull / attach throttling or min_replicas enforcement prevented spin-up.

raj_eng-runtime: Checked cluster events around 2441204840: several `ImagePullBackOff` and `attach-rate-limit` warnings for that account during warmup. Also saw `min_replicas_policy: strict` on pool (customer configured).

lisa_support: Customer insists they didn't change min_replicas. They were on default when we provisioned last month. Could policy drift have occurred?

ops_integrations: I pulled the pool config: min_replicas=2, max_replicas=20, policy=canary-rollout, warmup_mode=disabled. So strict min isn't the blocker, something else prevented pod creation.

raj_eng-runtime: Repro steps I ran locally (dev cluster): 1) set pool min=2, send 100rps spike, 2) observe desired jump, 3) if image pull + attach quota hit, pods stay Pending. Try `kubectl describe pod` shows `FailedScheduling` -> `AttachVolume: rate exceeded`.

maria_cs: Customer provided logs showing `AttachVolume rate exceeded` and repeated 429s. They also saw billing auth hits earlier today but billing team said no blocks.

devin_oncall: Short-term mitigation for customer: 1) increase min_replicas to 6 to pre-warm, 2) enable warmup_mode=pool (we can toggle for them), or 3) schedule a rolling restart window to re-cache images. Which do you prefer?

lisa_support: They want an immediate fix — set min_replicas=6 and enable warmup_mode for 2 hours while we deep-dive. I'll get consent.

raj_eng-runtime: I'll also file an infra ticket to audit attach/pull quotas for acme-corp across region eu-west-1. If noisy neighbor caused attach throttles, we need to correlate with other pools.

autoscale-bot: action_log: [2441204990] applied change(pool=acme-prod-eu): min_replicas 2->6 by lisa_support. warmup_mode=enabled (expires 244120... +2h)

maria_cs: Customer confirmed 10 minutes after change errors dropped to <1% and latency normalized. They are happy for now but requested root cause analysis and SLA credit check.

devin_oncall: Next steps: 1) Raj to investigate attach/image-pull throttling and noisy neighbor signals (IO/registry throttles) — correlate with pool neighbors. 2) Infra to check rate-limiter config for attach operations for that account. 3) CS to coordinate billing/SLA follow-up.

raj_eng-runtime: Will collect: kube events, node-level attach throttles, registry 429s, and autoscaler decision timelines. Expect initial findings in ~4-6h.

lisa_support: Logged customer follow-up and captured timeline. I'll also offer a short postmortem once we have root cause. :thumbsup:

maria_cs: Thanks team. Adding tag: sev2-escalation, priority-high. If anyone finds a quick config fix beyond the min bump, ping the thread.

devin_oncall: FYI — I left a note to avoid auto-scaling to zero test for this pool; there's a scheduled traffic blast tomorrow from customer load test — will coordinate a controlled pre-warm.

raj_eng-runtime: One more thing — if we see `desired_replicas > current` but `outstanding_provision=0`, that's a strong signal of infra-side attach/pull backpressure. We'll instrument extra metrics to catch this earlier.

maria_cs: Closing loop for now. I'll update ACME after Raj posts findings.
